sonnet.problem: Card 18 already asked about the last verse (12:20) and showed that Abram leaves with all his possessions. Card 19 tells that same fact again with 'ALL his possessions, camels included', so it works as a recap and reuses an answer already shown. It should be only the short 'story isn't over' line.
sonnet.rule: When the passage's last verse is asked on a choice card, the last story card can be just this line. ... No recap cards. ... An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
